correctness.rationale: The spherical harmonic addition formula identifies evaluation rank with the PSD Legendre Gram rank. Antipodality reduces the twenty-point matrix to ten points. Direct Q(sqrt5) geometry yields even Petersen-sector matrix C with C^2=2I-C+J and signed odd sector B with B^2=A+3I and B^3=5B; those identities prove the displayed eigenvalues and multiplicities, not a numerical rank guess. Exact rational Legendre recurrences determine all zero and nonzero eigensectors for degrees k=0..185, independently checked by direct 10x10 matrices at k<=20. The integral bound |P_k(x)|<=sqrt(pi/(2k(1-x^2))) yields 6|P_k(1/3)|+3|P_k(sqrt5/3)|<1 for k>=186, proving strict positivity for the infinite tail. The exact finite certificate and analytic tail together cover all k.

value.rationale: The regular dodecahedron is a canonical spherical sampling design. The contrast between exact-degree rank 9 at degree 4, rank 6 at degree 5, full rank at 6 and losses at 8 and 14 makes the precise rank sequence a natural nonmonotone interpolation invariant. Determining the sharp permanent threshold and every eigenvalue is a complete, reusable structural result, not a randomly selected low-degree table.

final_claim: The complete exact-degree spherical-harmonic evaluation rank sequence at the 20 regular dodecahedron vertices is 1,3,5,7,9,6 for degrees 0..5, rank 9 at 8 and 14, and rank 10 at all other k>=6. The exact parity-reduced Legendre Gram eigenvalues are given for every degree; 15 is the sharp permanent-surjectivity degree.
